controlTotal.label: Control total
controlTotal.help: Type the total printed on the vendor's document. Saving waits until the lines add up to it.

controlTotal.invalid: The control total isn't an amount. Type a number such as 1250.00, or clear it.

enterMovesToNextField.label: Enter moves to the next field
enterMovesToNextField.help: Enter walks across a line and on to the next one, as in desktop accounting systems. Off: Enter moves down the column.

autoDecimal.label: Place the decimal point automatically
autoDecimal.help: Type 1785 to enter 17.85 in amount fields — for ten-key entry. Typing a decimal point still works as usual.

keepDateOnNew.label: Keep the date on Save & new
keepDateOnNew.help: The next document starts with the date you just used.

keepPartyOnNew.label: Keep the vendor or customer on Save & new
keepPartyOnNew.help: For entering several documents from the same party.

recallLastDocument.label: When you pick a vendor or customer
recallLastDocument.help: Their most recent document of the same kind can fill the lines for you.

bulk.confirmPostTitle: Post {count, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}}?
